source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Select port 1 configuration and enable "Serial Port"
2. Change device setting to:
    a. Auto
    b. IO=3F8h; IRQ=4;
    c. IO=3F8h; IRQ=3,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12;
    d. IO=2F8h; IRQ=3,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12;
    e. IO=3E8h; IRQ=3,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12;
    f. IO=2E8h; IRQ=3,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12;
3. Save the change and reset
4. Check boot progress from COM port
5. Reboot into BIOS
6. Repeat step 1 to step 5 for different device setting
7. Select port 1 configuration and disable "Serial Port"
8. Save the change and reset
9. Check boot progress from COM port
10. Repeat step 1 to step 9 for all device settings and all available ports

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Serial port should be set to Enable successfully
2. System should be workable with all device settings
3. COM port terminal should display boot progress when enabled
4. Serial port should be set to Disable successfully
5. COM port terminal should NOT display boot progress when disabled
6. Device setting should be set for all available settings correctly

original_test_intent: Validate every available serial port across Auto and all source-listed I/O/IRQ settings: enabled states must persist, boot progress must appear on the mapped COM terminal, disabled states must suppress it, and the host must remain workable.
original_method: Map physical/virtual COM endpoints and resource ownership, have an engineer apply one approved BIOS setting and save/reset at a time, automatically capture the serial stream and host/OOB recovery evidence, repeat the complete matrix, then restore baseline.
manual_activity: An engineer must connect/map the serial path and apply/confirm BIOS settings and save/reset transitions; once configured, terminal capture, enabled-output detection, disabled silence, inventory and log collection can be automated.
required_inputs: All available port identities and connector/SOL mapping
Valid I/O/IRQ combinations for each port
safety_requirements: One approval may cover the complete unchanged matrix, but every I/O/IRQ value must be prevalidated.
Do not use the only management console without independent OOB recovery.
Stop on resource conflict, boot failure or lost management.
No automatic retry; do not hide failed combinations.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare matrix and check resource/port inventory.
After approved manual setup, capture timestamped serial output/silence and host/OOB logs for each state.
Compare coverage and report failures without changing unapproved BIOS values or issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve mappings/matrix and connect the correct terminal path.
Apply/confirm each BIOS setting and save/reset under the plan.
Restore baseline and issue final verdict.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run an approved per-port/per-resource state table with unique evidence IDs, serial capture from pre-reset through boot, OOB reachability and baseline restoration.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, UART/adapter, terminal and OS versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic identity, automated capture and failure traceability without omitting manual BIOS/physical setup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; all source settings and ports remain required unless an approved project plan explicitly documents scope.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Serial output absence is valid only after capture path health is independently established.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a subset only as that project's plan and must report excluded source combinations; it cannot claim the master all-ports/all-settings coverage completed.
expected_evidence: Terminal path/parameters and independent capture-path validation
Enabled boot-progress capture and disabled-state silence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria align on the serial matrix and enabled/disabled output. Missing platform port/resource mapping is readiness; DeepSeek mismatch is duplicate-code contamination.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and acceptance semantics are clear. Packages, mappings and approval make it ready and do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on partial classification and mapping/recovery gates; keyboard control is not elevated to a source acceptance criterion because Criteria do not require it.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates manual setup, automatable capture, execution status and engineer verdict and preserves project-override coverage reporting.

review_improvement: Turns a long, failure-prone reset matrix into traceable per-combination evidence while preserving every listed I/O/IRQ and port state.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source requires human BIOS/physical endpoint setup, but the repeatable core evidence after setup—serial stream presence/absence and system recovery—can be automatically captured. Therefore the formal class is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, not MANUAL ONLY.
